events.name: ECB Interest Rate Decision
events.note: Expected quarter-point hike; press conference at 14:45 CET

deep_analysis.text: Cross-asset flows lean risk-off with softer gold, firmer VIX, a weaker BTC and modest DXY strength, though the move is shallow rather than a decisive flight to safety. Equities are only mildly softer and yields are ticking up, suggesting rate repricing is doing more work than fear right now. Oil's sharp rally alongside copper strength muddies the pure risk-off read, hinting at supply-side or growth-linked pressures rather than broad de-risking. Headlines center on rising Fed hike bets ahead of CPI, keeping the dollar bloc supported. The next major catalyst is US CPI, followed closely by ECB and BoE decisions within the same session, likely to dictate near-term direction across major currencies.
